name: Slotopia
summary:
Enter a virtual luxury hotel casino where you can take a seat and play slot machines, table games, and more just like in a real casino.
Feel as if you are actually sitting in front of a slot machine, with immersive VR interactions that let you naturally pull the lever or press buttons using your own hands.
Around you, other players are enjoying their own games, creating a lively social casino atmosphere. When you hit a bonus or jackpot, you can celebrate together with cheers and congratulations from everyon
